learning_outcomes.text: Can analyze the mechanisms with computer aid.
Can make computer aided synthesis of mechanisms.
Can solve an engineering problem with computer aid.

syllabus_topics: Analysis of slider crank and four-bar mechanisms

Mechanism design by using computer programs other than Matlab
ADAMS computer program and its application
